CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
May 10, 2022 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
11.1
RECOGNITION OF GLEASON LAW OFFICES - It is recommended the City Council present Gene Gleason with a Certificate of Appreciation and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
11.1 Recognition of Gleason Law Offices
11.2
RECOGNITION OF HEALTHWAYS CHIROPRACTIC CLINIC - It is recommended the City Council present Dr. Stephen Smith and Dr. Andrea Smith with a Certificate of Appreciation and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
11.2 Recognition of Healthways Chiropractic Clinic
11.3
RECOGNITION OF TEMPLE BETH OHR'S 65TH ANNIVERSARY - It is recommended the City Council recognize Temple Beth Ohr for its 65th Anniversary and present a recognition plaque to Rabbi Mark Goldfarb.
11.3 Recognition of Temple Beth Ohr
11.4
PROCLAMATION FOR ASIAN AMERICAN AND PACIFIC ISLANDER HERITAGE MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim May 2022 as Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to May Nguyen, College and Career Counselor at La Mirada High School.
11.4 Proclamation for Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage Month
11.5
PROCLAMATION FOR OLDER AMERICANS MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim May 2022 as Older Americans Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Larry Torres.
11.5 Proclamation for Older Americans Month
11.6
PROCLAMATION FOR WATER SAFETY MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim May 2022 as Water Safety Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Aquatics Manager Liza Soto.
11.6 Proclamation for Water Safety Month
11.7
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEES FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Enrique Santana and Mark Veitch for their years of service and present them with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
11.7 Recognition of City Employees for Years of Service
12.
PUBLIC COMMENT
13.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
13.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of April 26, 2022.
13.1 Meeting Minutes of 4-26-22
13.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated May 10, 2022 in the total amount of $1,793,653.87.
13.2 Warrant Register
13.3
LA MIRADA TRANSIT SERVICES TITLE VI PLAN - It is recommended the City Council approve the non-discrimination and accessibility program for La Mirada Transit services in accordance with Federal Title VI and Federal Transit Administration policies.
13.3 La Mirada Transit Services Title VI Plan
13.4
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE REHEARSAL HALL DANCE FLOOR - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of a new rehearsal hall dance floor from American Harlequin Corp. at a cost not to exceed $47,539.64.
13.4 Authorization to Purchase Rehearsal Hall Dance Floor
13.5
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING FEBRUARY 2022 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending February 2022.
13.5 Monthly Treasurer Report
13.6
ORCHESTRATIONS FOR NEW MUSICAL PLAY - It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement with Hocker Music, Inc. to provide orchestrations and musical copying for “Did You See What Walter Paisley Did Today?” at a cost not to exceed $35,000.
13.6 Orchestrations for New Musical Play
13.7
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE AND INSTALL A SHADE SAIL SYSTEM AT LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase and installation of a proprietary product for the shade sail system for the patio café at La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts from Shade West, Inc. at a cost not to exceed $58,000.
13.7 Authorization to Purchase Shade Sail System
14.
PUBLIC HEARING
14.1
RESOLUTION NO. 22-11 APPROVING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE ENERGY CONSERVATION AND INFRASTRUCTURE RENEWAL PROGRAM - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law; adopt Resolution No. 22-11 approving the implementation of the energy conservation and infrastructure renewal program; find that the cost of the Energy Services Agreement to the City for the energy conservation services provided by Climatec LLC in the amount of $15,787,867 is less than the anticipated marginal cost to the City of thermal, electrical, or other energy that would have been consumed by the City in the absence of the energy conservation services and that it is in the best interest of the City to approve and enter into the Energy Services Agreement with Climatec LLC; approve the forms of the Energy Services Agreement by and between the City and Climatec LLC, in the forms on file with the City Clerk, subject to final approval by the City Manager and City Attorney; and authorize the City Manager, to execute and deliver to Climatec LLC the Energy Services Agreement and related documents as necessary to carry out the energy services contemplated therein, subject to such minor changes thereto as the City Manager may require and approve.
14.1 Report and Resolution No. 22-11
14.1 Agreement with Climatec LLC
